analysis.executive_summary: Documentation audit of https://ably.com/docs covered 693 pages across 2,071 discovered URLs with 100% crawl coverage. 8 confirmed broken internal links were found, all within user-facing documentation (0 repository links). 739 links could not be verified due to authentication or rate-limiting, representing a significant blind spot. API reference coverage stands at 52.49% across 71 detected API pages, and SEO/geo issues affect 44.3% of pages. Example code reliability is estimated at 87.33%, with 83.12% of pages showing last-updated metadata.
strengths: Complete crawl coverage achieved (100% of 2,071 in-scope pages)
Zero broken repository navigation links; all 8 broken links are user-facing and fixable
High example code reliability estimate at 87.33%
Strong last-updated metadata coverage at 83.12% of pages
71 API pages successfully detected with no detection failures flagged
risks: 739 unverified links create major uncertainty; 25% link confidence indicates potential hidden broken links behind auth/rate-limits
API reference coverage at 52.49% leaves nearly half of API surface undocumented or poorly linked
SEO/geo issue rate of 44.3% significantly impacts discoverability and search ranking
Overall confidence of 63.5% suggests moderate reliability gaps across multiple dimensions
Multi-project topology may hide cross-project linking issues not surfaced in this audit
8 confirmed broken internal links degrade user experience and trust
2,376 pages requested but only 693 crawled suggests potential scope or access restrictions limiting audit completeness

prioritized_actions.action: Fix all 8 confirmed broken internal documentation links immediately
Investigate and resolve 739 unverified links by addressing auth/rate-limit barriers or confirming validity
Increase API reference coverage from 52.49% to minimum 80% by documenting missing endpoints and improving cross-linking
Remediate SEO/geo issues affecting 44.3% of pages to improve search visibility and organic traffic
Analyze gap between 2,376 requested pages and 693 crawled to identify access barriers or scope misconfigurations

limitations: External audit cannot verify 739 links behind authentication, rate-limiting, or server blocks; actual broken link count may be higher
Crawl accessed only 693 of 2,376 requested pages; uncrawled content may contain additional issues not reflected in this analysis
API coverage detection relies on heuristics; actual documentation gaps may differ if API surface inventory is incomplete
Example code reliability is an estimate based on static analysis; runtime execution failures are not tested
Multi-project topology may obscure cross-project dependencies, versioning conflicts, or shared component issues not visible in aggregate metrics
